title: Privacy
intro: What this site collects, who can see it, and how to have it removed.

body: Using GAMSA needs no name, account or cookie. The only measurement is a cookie-free page-view count, and nothing collected is sold, shared with advertisers or used except to run the site.

Each page loads a small Cloudflare Web Analytics script recording the page, the referring page, your country, browser and device type, and page speed. It sets no cookies, uses no fingerprinting, does not track you between sites or build a profile, and reports only totals. Blocking static.cloudflareinsights.com stops it without affecting the site.

Cloudflare hosts the site and, like any host, processes each request (IP address, time, page, browser) to deliver and secure it, under [Cloudflare's privacy policy](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/). The site's own code records no IP addresses and does not link request details to anything else or use them to identify visitors. To prevent message floods, the forms hold a scrambled form of your IP address in memory for a few minutes; it is never stored. If your browser blocks part of a page under the site's safety rules, it reports the rule, the page and the source website; only daily counts are kept.

list: **Feedback**: your message, the page and topic, and an email address only if you want a reply.
**Patient sightings**: the medicine, suburb or postcode, the pharmacy name (optional), what happened and an optional note. No name is asked for.

**Pharmacist stock register**: your name, AHPRA registration number, pharmacy, suburb or postcode, the report, and a work email only if you give one. The registration number is checked once against the public AHPRA register and never shown. Once approved you receive a private report key, of which the site keeps only a scrambled copy.

All three forms use Cloudflare Turnstile to detect bots. It checks your browser, not your entries; for feedback and pharmacist reports it also passes your IP address to Cloudflare, which does not store it. Submissions are kept in a Cloudflare database that only the author can view through this site, although Cloudflare stores and processes them as the provider. Sightings and stock reports appear without names, emails or registration numbers and are removed from view after 14 days. The author's daily alert gives only the number of new messages, sightings and registrations, never their content or personal details. Deletion requests through the feedback page are honoured without question.

sections.h: Where it is kept and for how long
list: **Where**: Cloudflare, a US company, runs the database in its Oceania region; it offers no setting that keeps data inside Australia only ([Cloudflare: D1 data location](https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/configuration/data-location/)).
**How long**: there is no fixed deletion date yet. The author deletes what is no longer needed, and anything you sent sooner if you ask through the [feedback page](#/feedback).
**Access and correction**: ask through the [feedback page](#/feedback) to see, correct or delete what you sent.

**Backup**: a monthly backup is being set up but has not started. It will be encrypted, kept for 90 days on GitHub (a US company) so the database can be restored, and only the author will be able to unlock it. This page will say when it starts.

sections.h: What is stored on your device
body: The Accessibility panel and the light and dark buttons save your choices in this browser's local storage (names starting `gamsa.`); Discreet browsing uses only this tab's session storage and ends when the tab closes. None of it identifies you or leaves your device. Reset all clears saved choices but not Discreet browsing; Quick exit or clearing your browser data removes everything.

Pharmacists: the stock report form remembers your registration number, name, pharmacy, suburb and report key in this browser. They leave your device only when you post a report; Forget them, under the form, removes them, and they are not kept with Discreet browsing on.
Search runs in your browser and is not sent to a server. Read aloud uses your device's voices; some browsers' online voices (such as Chrome's Google voices) send the text to the browser maker.
Links to the TGA, PBS, Services Australia and support organisations lead to sites with their own privacy practices. PDFs and the RSS feed are plain files served from this site.

list: Sell, rent or trade information about you.
Advertise or share data with advertising networks.

Keep a record when you use Quick exit (or press Esc twice). It clears this site's saved settings and replaces the page with the Bureau of Meteorology weather site, so Back does not return to it; earlier gamsa.au pages in the same tab can still be reached unless Discreet browsing (Accessibility panel) was on. It cannot erase your browser history: use a private window (Safari: File → New Private Window; Chrome: New Incognito Window), or delete gamsa.au from your history afterwards (Safari: History → Show All History; Chrome: History; search gamsa and delete).

body: This page changes whenever data collection is added or removed. Questions or removal requests: [send feedback](#/feedback). Last reviewed 31 October 2026.

If you are unhappy with how your information has been handled, tell the author first through the [feedback page](#/feedback). To ask about or correct your personal information, you can also email gamsaenquiries@gmail.com. If that does not resolve it, contact the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC) at [oaic.gov.au](https://www.oaic.gov.au). For a concern about a health service, including a pharmacist, contact South Australia's Health and Community Services Complaints Commissioner (HCSCC) at [hcscc.sa.gov.au](https://www.hcscc.sa.gov.au).
